meta.name: affirmations
meta.description: Build a personal affirmation system for daily practice, custom affirmations, and mindset reinforcement.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建专属肯定语系统，每天强化积极心态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望通过日常肯定语提升自我认知和积极心态
copy.tagline_en: Build a personal affirmation system for daily practice and mindset reinforcement
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to build a daily affirmation habit to boost positivity and self-belief

howto.what: Claude会帮你建立一套日常肯定语句练习系统：根据你的需求定制肯定句，记录练习进度和共鸣内容，并在`~/Clawic/data/affirmations/`文件夹中保存相关文件。
howto.when: 当你请求建立或使用肯定语句系统时触发；或者当你分享焦虑、自我怀疑等挣扎时，Claude会根据情况提供对应的肯定语句。

say.text: 请给我今天的晨间肯定语句。
say.note: Claude会按你设定的偏好输出肯定句。

say.text: 我最近感到焦虑，请给我一些平静的肯定句。
say.note: Claude会提供安抚和 grounding 的句子。

say.text: 帮我创建一个关于自信的肯定列表。
say.note: Claude会引导你创建个性化肯定句。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you build a daily affirmation practice system: delivers custom affirmations based on your needs, tracks your practice and what resonates, and creates workspace files in `~/Clawic/data/affirmations/`.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to set up or use the affirmation system; or when you share struggles like anxiety or self-doubt, and Claude offers relevant affirmations.

say_en.text: Give me my morning affirmations for today.
say_en.note: Claude outputs affirmations per your preferences.

say_en.text: I've been feeling anxious, give me some calming affirmations.
Help me create a list of affirmations for confidence.
say_en.note: Claude guides you to personalize them.
